posts.name: Amber Subhani
posts.cooked: I wanted to know if the OPPE could get postponed due to the fact that i have my end semester examination on the 8th of december. I would also like to know as to the timings of the OPPE on the 8th.

posts.name: Somsubhra/সোমশুভ্র
posts.cooked: The OPPE is scheduled on 7th Dec, 7-9PM IST.

posts.name: Amber Subhani
posts.cooked: Can it be postponed, by any chance?

posts.name: Somsubhra/সোমশুভ্র
posts.cooked:
If you’re unavailable on 7th, you need to write an email for postponing your slot to 14th. But in that case, you won’t get any chance to re-attempt it this term if you are unable to qualify the OPPE.
Refer to the grading doc.
